# `Scanner/Explore-v0` · The scanner, nothing asked

**Status:** SANDBOX: no reward

The virtual scanner with a subject on the table and no task: for demos, for people at the command line (`mrgym play`), and for an agent to learn what the console does before it is asked for anything.

```python
import mrgym
env = mrgym.make("Scanner/Explore-v0", level=1, seed=0)
obs, info = env.reset()
obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info = env.step({"name": "scanner_info", "arguments": {}})
```

| Given | Deliver | Scored by |
|---|---|---|
| A head, an abdomen or a QA phantom at 1.5 or 3 T; one hour of scan time | Nothing | No reward |

## World

- On the table: keyword phantom = brain (default) | abdomen | qa; field_t = 3.0 (default) | 1.5; lesion = ms | tumour (brain), liver (abdomen)
- Sequences that matter here: spgr, afi, se, ir, bssfp, epi
- Formulas the agent is given: datasheet section 5

| Hidden (measurable only by scanning) | Told |
|---|---|
| the subject (anatomy and tissue values) | the instrument datasheet |
| fields and system state | budget and request limits |
| noise level | realised protocol, timing, limits and cost of every plan and scan |
| the 128-bit world seed |  |

## Tools

| Tool | Cost | Counts as scanner request | Ends episode |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scanner_info` | free | no | no |
| `plan` | free | yes | no |
| `scan` | scan time | yes | no |
| `read_regions` | free | no | no |
| `view` | free | no | no |
| `finish` | free | no | yes |

Limits: 512 scanner requests and 1024 tool calls per episode.

## Levels

| Level | Hidden-world prior | Budget (s) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | any subject | 3600 |

## Deliverable and reward

- Deliverable: `finish` with `{'notes': '<optional text>'}`
- Reward range [0.0, 0.0]; paid never

## What the agent reads at reset (level 1, seed 0)

~~~text
# Free exploration

You operate a virtual MR scanner at 3 T through tool calls. A head lies in the field of view. Nothing is asked and nothing is scored: plan and run any protocol, look at the images, read out regions. `finish` ends the session.

Budget: 3600 s of scan time, counted by the scanner. At most 512 scanner requests (plans + scans) and 1024 tool calls.
Tools: scanner_info (free); plan (free); scan (scan time); read_regions (free); view (free); finish (ends the episode).
[scan time 0.00/3600 s used · 3600.00 s left · scans 0 · scanner requests 0/512 · tool calls 0/1024]
~~~

## Determinism and versions

same (seed, keywords, tool calls) -> same observations and log hash chain; a repeated scan draws new noise.

Rewards are comparable only within one environment version (the `-vN` suffix) and one scanner engine (`mrgym --version`).
